create_DDPLoss_wrapper: create a DDPLoss wrapper with mse loss and mean reduction for distributed training
create_DDPMTLoss_wrapper: create a DDPMTLoss wrapper with l2mae loss and per_structure reduction for molecular tasks
register_custom_loss: register a custom loss function with the fairchem registry using the register_loss decorator
compute_per_atom_mae: compute per atom MAE loss by dividing predictions and targets by atom counts
compute_l2norm_loss: compute L2 norm loss on vector predictions like atomic forces with shape Nx3
